title: json_schemas
text: Add viewer like json-editor pkgdown website. Add custom JavaScript file (inst/pkgdown/assets/json-viewer.js) initialize JSON editor:
code: const schema = {        "$schema": "http://json-schema.org/draft-07/schema#",        "title": "Person",        "type": "object",        "properties": {            "name": {                "type": "string",                "description": "The person's name"            },            "age": {                "type": "integer",                "description": "The person's age",                "minimum": 0            }        },        "required": ["name", "age"]    };     const editor = new JSONEditor(document.getElementById("editor"), { schema: schema }); library(jsonlite) library(DiagrammeR)  # Parse JSON schema json_schema <- '{   "$schema": "http://json-schema.org/draft-07/schema#",   "title": "Person",   "type": "object",   "properties": {     "name": {       "type": "string",       "description": "The person\'s name"     },     "age": {       "type": "integer",       "description": "The person\'s age",       "minimum": 0     }   },   "required": ["name", "age"] }'  schema <- fromJSON(json_schema)  # Convert schema to a tree diagram tree <- grViz(" digraph json_schema {   graph [rankdir=LR]   node [shape=box, style=filled, color=lightblue]   'Schema' -> 'Properties'   'Properties' -> 'name'   'Properties' -> 'age'   'name' -> 'string'   'age' -> 'integer' }") tree
